description: Independent multi-family office founded 2011 (originally Lille/Marcq-en-Baroeul), now present on the Paris-Brussels axis and Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes. Neither clients, banks nor investment funds hold capital in the firm. Named best French multi-family office (Sommet du Patrimoine et de la Performance award, cited for 2025). 11-50 employees per LinkedIn. Co-founder Jerome Jambert sits on the AFFO board.
